author: crusadrzdaytona
body:
• crusadrzdaytona

  • Using Kill Arora on 1/28/15

  • So I’d like to start this off by saying, I have waited almost seven months for a crime I didn’t not commit. From what I remember, I was standing on a 2x1 Iron block pillar fighting back the other team on Nebula I was disconnected for hacking. I consider myself a rather good PVPist but I wouldn’t hack to win, it may also have happened because on that game there are many people who cry hacker while playing. If you join that for yourself it’s right there to see it, and maybe someone reported me thinking I was possibly because they may not be as good. Even if I had hacked, I believe seven months is enough for anyone besides notorious hackers anyways. Please consider my appeal I love nebula and I have not seen many servers with it, but I feel your server is by far the best at presenting it. If you need to contact me, my email is acrobex@outlook.com but I will follow this discussion for any response.

title: I am appealing for an Infraction

replies.author: izjust4fun
replies.body:
Hey Crusadr,

I've decided to appeal your ban due to the fact that you were punished more than half a year ago! If you're caught hacking again you will no longer have the chance to appeal.

Welcome back and enjoy the server! :)
